subject.title: [Bug]: Live Docs are ahead of release

question: Should docs.openclaw.ai be stable-release compatible by default, or latest-main with explicit version gating and config-error safeguards?
rationale: The source evidence proves the drift class still exists, but the durable fix is a docs/release policy choice rather than a narrow code repair.

options.title: Gate live docs against stable release
options.body: Make the public docs default to latest stable compatibility or block publishing config docs that mention keys absent from the latest stable schema.

options.title: Keep latest docs with version warnings
options.body: Continue publishing main-synced docs but require version availability badges and friendlier config validation for known newer keys.

options.title: Defer to bundled-docs work only
options.body: Treat latest-only public docs as intentional and rely on https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/71301 for installed-version guidance, accepting continued web-doc drift.

recommendation.title: Gate live docs against stable release
recommendation.body: Make the public docs default to latest stable compatibility or block publishing config docs that mention keys absent from the latest stable schema.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent docs rewrite and docs publish workflow history make this the strongest available owner for the public docs policy decision.
